sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A BELT OF STRONGER WESTERLIES...WITH A COUPLE OF SIGNIFICANT EMBEDDED SHORT WAVE IMPULSES...IS IN THE PROCESS OF PROGRESSING THROUGH THE NORTHERN TIER OF THE WESTERN AND CENTRAL U.S...AND APPEARS LIKELY TO CONTINUE NOSING EAST NORTHEASTWARD DURING THIS FORECAST PERIOD. THE LEAD IMPULSE...INCLUDING A DEVELOPING LOWER AND MID TROPOSPHERIC CYCLONE...APPEARS LIKELY TO LIFT NORTH OF THE CENTRAL INTERNATIONAL BORDER AREA...WITH THE PRIMARY SURFACE LOW MIGRATING FROM SOUTHERN SASKATCHEWAN THROUGH CENTRAL MANITOBA INTO THE NORTHERN MANITOBA/ONTARIO BORDER AREA BY 12Z FRIDAY. GUIDANCE IS SUGGESTIVE THAT A SECONDARY LOW WILL WEAKEN AS IT LIFTS NORTHEASTWARD OUT OF EASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA. BUT A DEVELOPING FRONTAL ZONE...PERHAPS REINFORCED BY OUTFLOW FROM MORNING CONVECTION...STILL APPEARS LIKELY TO LIFT NORTHWARD THROUGH CENTRAL MINNESOTA DURING THE DAY...AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT ADVANCING SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE NORTHERN PLAINS. TO THE SOUTH...WEAK CYCLONIC FLOW WILL PERSIST ACROSS THE CALIFORNIA COAST INTO THE FOUR CORNERS REGION...WITH PERHAPS AT LEAST ONE IMPULSE PROGRESSING OUT OF THIS REGIME INTO THE CENTRAL PLAINS. MEANWHILE...AS WEAK UPPER TROUGHING CONTINUES TO DEVELOP OFF THE ATLANTIC

sections.title: UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY
sections.text: CONVECTION CURRENTLY DEVELOPING EASTWARD ACROSS EASTERN NORTH DAKOTA AND ADJACENT NORTHEASTERN SOUTH DAKOTA LIKELY WILL PERSIST BEYOND 12Z...BUT IS EXPECTED TO WEAKEN/DISSIPATE AS IT SPREADS ACROSS NORTHERN MINNESOTA EARLY THIS MORNING. IN ITS WAKE...ALONG/SOUTH OF A RETREATING OUTFLOW/NORTHWARD ADVANCING WARM FRONT...CONSIDERABLE LOW-LEVEL MOISTENING IS EXPECTED IN A PRE-COLD FRONTAL CORRIDOR ACROSS NORTHWESTERN/NORTH CENTRAL IOWA INTO EAST CENTRAL MINNESOTA. COINCIDING WITH STEEPENING MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...MODELS INDICATE MIXED LAYER CAPE WILL INCREASE TO AROUND 1500-2000+ J/KG...AS DEEP LAYER FLOW FIELDS AND SHEAR STRENGTHEN AHEAD OF THE UPPER IMPULSE. ALTHOUGH STRONGER FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION MAY PASS MOSTLY TO THE NORTH OF THE REGION...LIFT SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO CONTRIBUTE TO CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT DURING THE AFTERNOON HOURS. 30-50+ KT LOWER/MID TROPOSPHERIC WIND FIELDS...VEERING WITH HEIGHT...WILL PROVIDE MORE THAN SUFFICIENT SHEAR FOR ORGANIZED CONVECTION... INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY MAY BE CAPABLE OF PRODUCING VERY LARGE HAIL...LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...AS WELL AS A FEW TORNADOES...PARTICULARLY NEAR THE EFFECTIVE WARM FRONT ACROSS PARTS

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS
sections.text: DETAILS OF POTENTIAL CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION REMAIN UNCLEAR SOUTH OF THE STRONGER WESTERLIES. BUT MOST GUIDANCE IS SUGGESTIVE THAT AT LEAST ONE IMPULSE EMERGING FROM THE GREAT BASIN WILL CONTRIBUTE TO CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS INTO THE MIDDLE MISSOURI VALLEY LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. MID- LEVEL COOLING TO THE SOUTH OF THE MAIN UPPER IMPULSE LIFTING INTO CANADA IS EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE TO WEAKENING INHIBITION ACROSS THIS REGION...AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER CONTINUES TO MOISTEN AND BECOME MODERATE TO STRONGLY UNSTABLE WITH DAYTIME HEATING. MIXED LAYER CAPE OF 2000-3000 J/KG APPEARS POSSIBLE ACROSS A SIZABLE AREA...SUPPORTIVE OF THE DEVELOPMENT OF ONE OR TWO LARGE STORM CLUSTERS. LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE IN INITIAL CONVECTION... WITH DOWNBURSTS AND STRONG COLD POOL DEVELOPMENT ACCOMPANIED BY POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS EVENTUALLY BECOMING MORE PROMINENT BEFORE ACTIVITY WEAKENS LATE THIS EVENING. ..KERR/GARNER.. 06/14/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: THE MAIN BELT OF THE WLYS WILL PERSIST FROM THE PACIFIC NW ACROSS THE NRN RCKYS AND NRN PLNS TO THE UPR GRT LKS THIS PERIOD...NW OF A WEAK RIDGE OVER THE MID MS AND OH VLYS. THE RIDGE WILL SOMEWHAT AMPLIFY AS FAIRLY STRONG UPR LOW/SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW OVER SE SK/WRN ND MOVES ENE INTO NW ONT. A SECONDARY BELT OF ENHANCED W TO NW FLOW WILL ARC FROM CNTRL NM ACROSS SE TX INTO THE NRN GULF OF MEXICO. WITHIN THIS FLOW...RADAR AND SATELLITE DATA CONTINUE TO SHOW THE PRESENCE OF TWO MCVS...ONE NOW OVER THE SABINE RVR VLY AND THE OTHER THE FL PANHANDLE. BOTH MCVS SHOULD MOVE SLOWLY ESE THROUGH THE PERIOD. AT LWR LVLS...SFC WAVE NOW IN ERN SD SHOULD WEAKEN AS IT MOVES NE INTO MN...WITH THE MAIN SFC LOW TRACKING ENE ACROSS SRN MB AND WRN ONT LATER TODAY/TNGT. COLD FRONT EXTENDING SSW FROM THE SD LOW IS EXPECTED TO ADVANCE E/SE INTO THE UPR MS VLY/CNTRL PLNS TNGT...BUT SHOULD BECOME QSTNRY FROM UPR MI TO NW KS BY 12Z FRI. THE COLD FRONT AND...TO A LESSER EXTENT...LEE TROUGH/DRY LINE IN THE CNTRL HIGH PLNS...WILL BE THE MAIN FOCUS FOR ORGANIZED STRONG TO SVR STORMS THIS PERIOD.

sections.title: UPR MS VLY TODAY/TNGT
sections.text: COMPLEX...LOOSELY ORGANIZED TSTM SYSTEM NOW OVER CNTRL MN/WRN WI IS ELEVATED ATOP RESIDUAL COOL DOME ASSOCIATED WITH RETREATING GRT LKS SFC HIGH. SUFFICIENT ELEVATED CAPE APPEARS PRESENT /PER MPX RAOB/ FOR SVR HAIL IN SUSTAINED UPDRAFTS AS THE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM CONTINUES SLOWLY EWD. ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT MAY OCCUR ON ITS SRN AND SWRN FLANK...SUPPORTED BY PERSISTENT...SLOWLY MOISTENING...40 KT SSWLY LLJ. IN THE WAKE OF THE MN MCS...AND S OF ASSOCIATED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...APPRECIABLE LOW LVL MOISTENING IS EXPECTED BY AFTN AHEAD OF ESE-ADVANCING COLD FRONT FROM WRN/CNTRL MN SSW INTO SE SD AND NW IA. COUPLED WITH SFC HEATING AND CONTINUING PRESENCE OF DEEP EML...EXPECT SBCAPE TO RANGE FROM 1500 TO 2500 J/KG BY AFTN. AS DEEP WSWLY FLOW AND SHEAR STRENGTHEN ON SRN FRINGE OF UPR IMPULSE...SETUP COULD SUPPORT SUPERCELLS/SUSTAINED STORMS WITH HAIL/HIGH WIND AND TORNADOES...DESPITE FACT THAT STRONGER FORCING FOR ASCENT WILL PASS N OF REGION. THE TORNADO THREAT SHOULD BE GREATEST NEAR RETREATING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER CNTRL/ERN MN AND ADJACENT NW WI...BEFORE DIMINISHING THIS EVE.

sections.title: CNTRL PLNS THIS AFTN THROUGH TNGT
sections.text: DETAILS OF CONVECTIVE EVOLUTION STILL REMAIN NEBULOUS S OF THE MAIN BELT OF THE WLYS. BUT SATELLITE AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SHOW A SERIES OF WEAK DISTURBANCES OVER GRT BASIN/CNTRL RCKYS THAT WILL BE CONTINUING E ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLNS LATER TODAY/TNGT. THESE MAY ENHANCE DIURNALLY-DRIVEN STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG COLD FRONT AND LEE TROUGH/DRY LINE OVER SRN/ERN NEB AND WRN KS/FAR ERN CO LATE THIS AFTN AND EVE. WHILE WSWLY MID LVL FLOW WILL REMAIN MODEST...PRESENCE OF DEEP EML ATOP A MOISTENING AND WARMING BOUNDARY LAYER /WITH PW INCREASING TO AOA 1.50 INCHES/ SHOULD LEAD TO CONSIDERABLE INSTABILITY...WITH SBCAPE TO 4000 J/KG. THIS SHOULD PROVE FAVORABLE FOR STORMS WITH BOTH LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND. GIVEN FOCUS FOR LOW LVL ASCENT PROVIDED BY THE STALLING FRONT...AND NOCTURNAL/DYNAMIC STRENGTHENING OF SLY LLJ AFTER SUNSET...THE STORMS COULD EVOLVE INTO A LARGE MCC. SUCH A SYSTEM COULD YIELD MORE NUMEROUS INSTANCES OF DMGG WIND/SVR HAIL BEFORE IT WEAKENS EARLY FRI.

sections.title: E TX/GULF CST TODAY THROUGH EARLY FRI
sections.text: COMBINATION OF VERY MOIST AIR /PW AROUND 1.75 INCHES/ AND PERIODIC UPLIFT INVOF AFOREMENTIONED MCVS EXPECTED TO FOSTER A CONTINUING RISK FOR STRONG TO OCCASIONALLY SVR TSTMS WITH HAIL AND LOCALLY DMGG WIND FROM E TX E/SE ALONG THE CNTRL AND ERN GULF CST. WEAK DEEP SHEAR WILL LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION AND SUSTENANCE. AN EXCEPTION WILL BE OVER E/SE TX AND WRN LA...WHERE 30 KT NWLY SHEAR MAY SUPPORT A FEW LONGER-LIVED CELLS. WHILE ALL THE STORMS WILL BE DIURNALLY ENHANCED...SPORADIC SVR ACTIVITY MAY PERSIST THROUGH EARLY FRI. ..CORFIDI/LEITMAN.. 06/14/2012

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: COMPACT SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED 50-60 KT MIDLEVEL JET STREAK OVER SRN SASKATCHEWAN/MANITOBA INTO THE DAKOTAS WILL TRANSLATE NEWD INTO ONTARIO IN ADVANCE OF AN UPSTREAM SYSTEM PROGRESSING THROUGH THE CANADIAN ROCKIES AND NRN INTERMOUNTAIN REGION. FARTHER SOUTH...WATER VAPOR IMAGERY AND LATEST MODEL GUIDANCE INDICATE THAT A NUMBER OF WEAK IMPULSES WILL MOVE FROM THE CNTRL/SRN ROCKIES INTO THE ADJACENT PLAINS DURING THE D1 PERIOD. AT THE SURFACE...NRN EXTENSION OF COLD FRONT FROM THE ERN DAKOTAS INTO CNTRL HIGH PLAINS WILL MOVE THROUGH THE UPPER MS VALLEY INTO UPPER MIDWEST WHILE SRN END STALLS DUE TO LEE CYCLONE DEVELOPMENT OVER ERN CO. A WARM FRONT --ENHANCED BY CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW-- OVER CNTRL MN WILL LIFT NWD WITHIN A PERSISTENT LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME...WHILE ELSEWHERE A DRYLINE/LEE TROUGH SHARPENS OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY/UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: SWRN FLANK OF NOCTURNAL...MN/WI MCS MAY PERSIST TODAY OWING TO SUSTAINED WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT INVOF WARM FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. ADDITIONAL STORM DEVELOPMENT IS ANTICIPATED BY AFTERNOON ALONG COLD FRONT AS DEEP-LAYER ASCENT IS ENHANCED BY DAKOTAS SHORTWAVE TROUGH. 12Z MPX SOUNDING SAMPLED THE PRESENCE OF STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND THE POTENTIAL FOR DOWNWARD MIXING OF HIGHER MOISTURE CONTENT...ALLOWING MLCAPE VALUES TO INCREASE TO 1000-2000 J/KG IN AREAS THAT EXPERIENCE STRONGER DAYTIME HEATING. THIS INSTABILITY WILL COINCIDE WITH GRADUALLY STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER SHEAR --OWING TO THE EWD PROGRESSION OF MIDLEVEL JET STREAK MENTIONED ABOVE-- WITH ENVIRONMENT BECOMING FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. THE GREATEST THREAT FOR A FEW TORNADOES WILL EXIST ALONG WARM FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE ENHANCED AND LCL HEIGHTS WILL REMAIN LOWER.

sections.title: MID MO VALLEY INTO SRN PLAINS
sections.text: 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS SHOW THE COLOCATION OF AN EML WITH LOWEST 100-MB MEAN-MIXING RATIOS OF 12-15 G/KG ACROSS WARM SECTOR WHICH WILL YIELD A MODERATE-STRONGLY UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT BY AFTERNOON WITH MLCAPE OF 2000-4000+ J/KG. CONVERGENCE ALONG THE COLD FRONT AND DRYLINE WILL BE AUGMENTED BY FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH WEAK PERTURBATIONS MOVING OUT OF THE ROCKIES TO FOSTER WIDELY SCATTERED TSTMS WITH THE POTENTIAL FOR UPSCALE GROWTH INTO MULTIPLE CLUSTERS/MCSS TONIGHT. MID AND HIGH-LEVEL WIND FIELD WILL REMAIN RATHER WEAK...THOUGH FORECAST KINEMATIC PROFILES DO INDICATE VEERING WINDS WITH HEIGHT...RESULTING IN DEEP-LAYER SHEAR APPROACHING 30 KT. THE MARGINAL KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT WILL BE COMPENSATED FOR BY THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY WITH SUPERCELLS POSSIBLE AS THE INITIAL CONVECTIVE MODE WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. EXPECT AN ISOLATED WIND/HAIL THREAT TO CONTINUE INTO TONIGHT IN CONJUNCTION WITH EVOLVING TSTM CLUSTERS/MCSS.

sections.title: ERN TX/WRN LA
sections.text: TSTMS WILL LIKELY PERSIST TODAY...FORCED BY WEAK WAA/ISENTROPIC ASCENT ALONG/E OF NNW-SSE ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER ERN TX. 12Z FWD/LCH SOUNDINGS SAMPLED THE PRESENCE OF A VERY MOIST ENVIRONMENT ALONG ERN EDGE OF EML WHICH WILL RESULT IN A MODERATE-STRONGLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS BY AFTERNOON. THOUGH VERTICAL SHEAR WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY WEAK...THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LAPSE RATES AND HIGH PW CONTENT INDICATE A RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WITH THE MOST INTENSE STORMS. ..MEAD/MOSIER.. 06/14/2012

sections.title: UPPER MS VALLEY/UPPER MIDWEST
sections.text: AIRMASS CONTINUES TO SLOWLY BUT STEADILY DESTABILIZE AT MID-AFTERNOON ACROSS MN IN THE WAKE OF AN EARLY DAY MCS...ESPECIALLY ACROSS WESTERN/SOUTHERN MN ALONG/SOUTHWEST OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY/WARM FRONT. SEVERE HAIL/WIND ARE STILL EXPECTED TO BE THE PRIMARY HAZARDS AS TSTMS INCREASE THROUGH LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. AS ADDRESSED IN MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1162 /SEE FOR MORE DETAILS/...SHORT-TERM UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING THE LIKELIHOOD/EXTENT OF A TORNADO THREAT ACROSS CENTRAL/SOUTHERN MN GIVEN REGENERATIVE CONVECTION ATOP THE COLD POOL AS OF MID-AFTERNOON /IN SPITE OF STRONG SHEAR/.

sections.title: MIDDLE MO VALLEY AND CENTRAL/SOUTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: NO CHANGES FROM PRIOR OUTLOOK...SEE EARLIER DISCUSSION BELOW AND SUBSEQUENT MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS/WATCHES.

sections.title: EAST TX AND LA
sections.text: WHILE SEVERE HAIL/WIND WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING ACROSS THE REGION ON THE SOUTHERN/WESTERN PERIPHERY OF AN EARLY DAY MCV AND NEAR ASSOCIATED OUTFLOW...CURRENT OBSERVATIONAL TRENDS/SHORT TERM GUIDANCE IMPLY THAT THE OVERALL THREAT WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY MARGINAL/ISOLATED. FOR THESE REASONS...HAVE REMOVED THE CATEGORICAL SLIGHT RISK ACROSS THE REGION. ..GUYER.. 06/14/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1122 AM CDT THU JUN 14 2012/

sections.title: SOUTH CENTRAL PLAINS INTO PARTS OF THE MID MO VALLEY
sections.text: VIGOROUS CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS BECOMING FAIRLY EXTENSIVE WITHIN AN AXIS SOUTH OF THE COLD FRONT...ACROSS PARTS OF WESTERN KANSAS AND SOUTHERN NEBRASKA. THE ENVIRONMENT TO THE SOUTH OF THIS ACTIVITY REMAINS STRONGLY HEATED AND DEEPLY MIXED WITH MODERATE TO LARGE CAPE ACROSS A BROAD AREA OF THE SOUTH CENTRAL PLAINS. AND A MODERATE SOUTHERLY LOW-LEVEL JET /30-40+ KT AT 850 MB/ IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT A SOUTHWARD PROPAGATION OF CONVECTION THIS EVENING. THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES ARE FAVORABLE FOR DOWNBURSTS AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF A CONSOLIDATED...STRONG DEEP SOUTHWARD SURGING COLD POOL ACROSS CENTRAL KANSAS THROUGH THE 03-06Z TIME FRAME...WHICH PROBABLY WILL BE ACCOMPANIED BY STRONG AND POTENTIALLY DAMAGING SURFACE GUSTS.

sections.title: UPPER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY
sections.text: MODELS INDICATE CONSIDERABLE WEAKENING OF THE CYCLONIC MID-LEVEL JET...ASSOCIATED WITH THE MANITOBA CLOSED LOW...AS IT LIFTS NORTH OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER THROUGH CENTRAL ONTARIO TONIGHT. STRONGER MID/UPPER FORCING FOR UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION ALREADY APPEARS NORTH OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER...AND SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL APPEARS TO BE DIMINISHING ACROSS THE REGION. SOUTHERLY PRE-COLD FRONTAL 850 MB FLOW DOES APPEAR LIKELY TO REMAIN AT LEAST MODERATELY STRONG /30+ KT/ THROUGH MUCH OF THE NIGHT ACROSS NORTHEAST IOWA INTO CENTRAL WISCONSIN. THIS SEEMS TO SUPPORT AT LEAST LOW PROBABILITIES FOR POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WITH LINGERING CONVECTION...PARTICULARLY WITH THE STORM CLUSTER CONTINUING TO EVOLVE TO THE SOUTH/SOUTHEAST OF THE MINNEAPOLIS/ST. PAUL AREA.

sections.title: SOUTHWESTERN ALABAMA
sections.text: DEEP LAYER FLOW FIELDS AND SHEAR ARE WEAK ACROSS THE GULF COAST REGION...BUT A COUPLE OF STRONG SURFACE GUSTS BRIEFLY APPROACHING SEVERE LIMITS MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION WITH A CONVECTIVELY GENERATED COLD POOL ADVANCING WESTWARD TOWARD THE REGION. THE BOUNDARY LAYER AROUND MOBILE BAY AND ADJACENT GULF COASTAL AREAS APPEARS TO REMAIN MODERATELY UNSTABLE AND SUPPORTIVE OF RENEWED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE COLD POOL THROUGH THE 02-04Z TIME FRAME.

sections.title: SOUTHERN FLORIDA
sections.text: CONSOLIDATING VIGOROUS STORM DEVELOPMENT MAY PERSIST ACROSS THE MIAMI-DADE/BROWARD COUNTY AREA THROUGH 02-03Z...WITH A RISK FOR LOCALIZED STRONG...POTENTIALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS...AND SOME HAIL. ..KERR.. 06/15/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STORMS WILL PERSIST THIS MORNING...AND A FEW COULD CONTAIN MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND GUSTY WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG WARM ADVECTION IS OCCURRING ON THE NOSE OF A SWLY LOW LEVEL JET. THIS IS HELPING TO MAINTAIN AN ELEVATED BOW NW OF THE TWIN CITIES...AND INITIATING NEW CONVECTION ALONG THE THETA-E GRADIENT OVER NWRN WI. SOME OF THESE STORMS APPEAR TO HAVE CONTAIN HAIL UP TO 1.00 INCH DIAMETER. THE 12Z MPX SOUNDING INDICATES STEEP LAPSE RATES ALOFT BUT RELATIVELY DISORGANIZED FLOW. THEREFORE...A CONTINUATION OF CURRENT TRENDS IS EXPECTED...WITH SOME BACK BUILDING POSSIBLE NEAR MSP/STP AREA AND SOME HAIL AND HEAVY RAIN.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM INITIATION IS EXPECTED DURING THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. AMPLE INSTABILITY SHOULD PROMOTE SEVERE STORMS WITH THE PRIMARY THREAT OF LARGE HAIL. ONE OR MORE WW MAY BE NEEDED OVER PORTIONS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORM INITIATION IS EXPECTED DURING THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS AS A COLD FRONT PUSHES SEWD INTO A VERY UNSTABLE AIR MASS. 18Z SURFACE ANALYSIS DEPICTS A SFC LOW ACROSS WRN MN WITH A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWD TO NEAR OFK AND THEN SWWD TO GLD. SURFACE TEMPERATURES AHEAD OF THE FRONT WERE IN THE UPPER 80S TO LOW 90S WITH MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTING MLCAPE VALUES A0A 3000 J/KG WITH LITTLE TO NO MLCINH REMAINING. INCREASED LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH FRONTAL BOUNDARY AND A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING NEWD INTO THE PLAINS WILL LIKELY RESULT IN CONVECTIVE INITIATION DURING THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. WEAK SHEAR /EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR BELOW 25 KTS AND 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR BELOW 30 KTS/ WILL LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION BUT LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS STORMS UTILIZE COPIOUS INSTABILITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STORMS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP OVER SWRN MN BY 20-21Z AND SUBSEQUENTLY INTO EXTREME SERN SD...NERN NEB AND NWRN IA. PRIMARY THREATS WILL BE ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND. WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ONCE INITIATION APPEARS IMMINENT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN EXPANSIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY STRETCHES FROM CNTRL WI WWD THROUGH SWRN MN THEN NWWD INTO SWRN MN WHERE IT INTERSECTS A COLD FRONT THAT STRETCHES SWWD THROUGH CNTRL NEB. WARM SECTOR TO THE SOUTH OF THESE BOUNDARIES HAS BECOME MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH 1500-2000 J/KG MLCAPE WHERE PLUME OF STEEPER LAPSE RATES HAVE ADVECTED ABOVE THE MOIST AXIS. CUMULUS HAS BEEN INCREASING ALONG SWRN PORTIONS OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IN SW MN WHERE DIABATIC WARMING IS ALSO OCCURRING. INITIAL STORMS WILL PROBABLY DEVELOP WITHIN THE ZONE OF ENHANCED CONVERGENCE AT THE COLD FRONT/OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTION IN SWRN MN. THIS ACTIVITY WILL SUBSEQUENTLY MOVE EAST AND LIKELY BECOME ELEVATED ABOVE THE COLD POOL LIMITING THE PRIMARY THREAT TO LARGE HAIL. HOWEVER...IF SUFFICIENT DIABATIC WARMING CAN OCCUR JUST ON THE COOL SIDE OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...THE TORNADO THREAT WOULD BE GREATER. OTHERWISE...OTHER STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP SWWD ALONG THE COLD FRONT FROM SWRN MN...EXTREME SERN SD INTO NERN NEB AND NWRN IA WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THE MAIN THREATS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW STORMS MAY DEVELOP AND POSE SOME RISK FOR ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. CURRENT THINKING IS THAT COVERAGE OF ANY SEVERE EVENTS WILL REMAIN TOO SPARSE FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AXIS OF 1000 J/KG MLCAPE HAS DEVELOPED OVER EXTREME ERN ND AND NWRN MN WHERE DIABATIC WARMING IS OCCURRING ALONG PRE-FRONTAL MOIST AXIS AND WEST OF A LARGE AREA OF CLOUDS LEFT FROM EARLIER CONVECTION. A FEW STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE FROM EXTREME NERN ND INTO NW MN AS ZONE OF MID LEVEL ASCENT ASSOCIATED WITH A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH BEGINS TO OVERTAKE THE COLD FRONT. VERTICAL SHEAR HAS INCREASED TO 45+ KT IN THIS REGION SUPPORTIVE OF UPDRAFT ROTATION WITH ANY STORMS THAT MANAGE TO DEVELOP. SPATIAL EXTENT OF THE SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN LIMITED OWING TO THE NARROW INSTABILITY AXIS. STORM COVERAGE IS ALSO IN QUESTION GIVEN WEAK LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE AND TENDENCY FOR PRE-FRONTAL BOUNDARY LAYER WINDS TO VEER WITH TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DEVELOPMENT OF ISOLATED TO SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS IS EXPECTED ACROSS WRN PORTIONS OF THE TX AND OK PANHANDLES NWD INTO FAR SERN CO AND FAR SWRN KS. PRIMARY SEVERE THREATS WITH THESE STORMS ARE LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED OVER A PORTION OF THE AREA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS CONVECTIVE INITIATION IS OCCURRING ALONG THE TX/NM BORDER TO THE W OF LBB...AHEAD OF A WEAK SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING NEWD OUT OF NRN MEXICO. LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS SHORTWAVE TROUGH AS WELL AS CONTINUED BOUNDARY LAYER HEATING SHOULD PROMOTE THUNDERSTORM INITIATION ACROSS THE TX AND OK PANHANDLES DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. FARTHER N...LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH THE APPROACHING SHORTWAVE SHOULD HELP DEEPEN A SFC LOW LOCATED ACROSS SERN CO/SWRN KS AND INCREASE THE CHANCE OF TSTM DEVELOPMENT. CURRENT TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS NERN NM HAS BEEN STEADILY INCREASING. ELY STORM MOTION WILL ALLOW THE STORMS THAT DO DEVELOP TO PROGRESS INTO A MORE UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT /19Z MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTS MLCAPE VALUE AOA 1500 J/KG ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA/. WEAKLY SHEARED ENVIRONMENT WILL LIKELY LIMIT STORM ORGANIZATION FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. HOWEVER...MID-LEVEL FLOW IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE AND THIS COULD HELP AID IN FURTHER DEVELOPMENT AS WELL AS INTENSIFY ANY ONGOING ACTIVITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WILL EXIST ACROSS SWRN TX LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY NIGHT. LIMITED COVERAGE OF THE SVR THREAT IS EXPECTED TO PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS HAS RECENTLY DEVELOPED ON A DRYLINE 30 W OF FST...WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE N AND S OF THIS AREA BASED ON DEEPENING CUMULUS OBSERVED IN VIS SATELLITE IMAGERY. SURFACE AIRMASS IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES FROM 100-105F AND DEWPOINTS IN THE 40S AND 50S. GIVEN THE LARGE TEMPERATURE/DEWPOINT SPREADS AND STEEP LOW/MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES...ENVIRONMENT WILL SUPPORT DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. IN ADDITION...LOW-LEVEL SLYS VEERING TO WLY IN THE MIDLEVELS MAY AID IN MARGINAL STORM ORGANIZATION AND ENHANCE UPDRAFT STRENGTH GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE CAPE AND STEEP LAPSE RATES. THUS...ISOLATED LARGE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS WELL. HOWEVER...OVERALL COVERAGE OF SVR WIND/HAIL THREAT IS EXPECTED TO BE LIMITED...WHICH SHOULD PRECLUDE THE NEED FOR A WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE IN WATCHES 390 AND 391 FROM WRN IA SWWD INTO NW KS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS PARTS OF NRN KS AND FAR NW MO LATER THIS EVENING AS THE STORMS MOVE GRADUALLY ESEWD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT EXTENDING FROM NW IA SWWD INTO SRN NEB ON WHICH A BROKEN LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING. SFC DEWPOINTS SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY ARE IN THE MID 60S F WITH TEMPS RANGING FROM THE UPPER 80S F IN WRN IA TO THE UPPER 90S F IN NRN KS. THIS IS RESULTING IN STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MESOANALYSIS ESTIMATING MLCAPE FROM 2500 TO 4000 J/KG. IN ADDITION TO THE PRISTINE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT...THE WSR-88D VWP AT HASTINGS SHOWS ABOUT 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR WHICH ALONG WITH THE INSTABILITY AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL. AS STORMS INCREASE IN COVERAGE THIS EVENING...A NEARLY CONTINUOUS LINE MAY DEVELOP WHICH COULD HELP THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT TO BECOME ENHANCED WITH BOWING LINE SEGMENTS. SHORT-TERM MODELS MOVE THE LINE GRADUALLY ESEWD INTO NE KS...SW IA AND FAR NW MO LATER THIS EVENING WHERE WW ISSUANCE CAN NOT BE RULED OUT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR WEATHER THREAT FOR WW 392 CONTINUES. AREAS DOWNSTREAM OF WW 392 OVER WRN OK AND NWRN TX WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR INCREASING SVR WEATHER THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 01Z...COMPOSITE RADAR IMAGERY SHOWED A LINE OF STORMS EXTENDED SWWD INTO SWRN KS...WHILE AN ARCING LINE OF STORM CLUSTERS EXTENDED SWD ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE. AREA RAOBS AT 00Z...AS WELL AS OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS GUIDANCE...INDICATE THAT THE AIRMASS AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY IS STRONGLY UNSTABLE...WITH AN MUCAPE VALUE DERIVED FROM THE OUN SOUNDING NEAR 5500 J/KG. THIS INSTABILITY...COMBINED WITH A STRENGTHENING LOW-LVL SLY JET MAY AID IN STORM MAINTENANCE AND INTENSITY AS ACTIVITY APPROACHES THE ERN EDGE OF WW 392. HOWEVER...SHORT-TERM MODEL GUIDANCE ALSO INDICATES THAT CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL INCREASE SUBSTANTIALLY AFTER SUNSET. THUS...IT IS UNCERTAIN WHETHER AN ADDITIONAL WW WILL BE NEEDED...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED AS STORMS APPROACH WRN OK AND NWRN TX. ..GARNER.. 06/15/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT ACROSS SRN MN AND WRN WI IS EXPECTED TO BECOME INCREASINGLY MARGINAL TOWARD WW 389 EXPIRATION AT 03Z. HAIL AND STRONG WING GUSTS ALONG WITH VERY HEAVY RAIN WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. WW ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED THIS EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING ACROSS SRN MN LOCATED ON THE NERN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE MESOANALYSIS SHOWS MLCAPE VALUES FROM 1000 TO 1500 J/KG. THIS COMBINED WITH MODERATE DEEP LAYER SHEAR PROFILES EVIDENT ON REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT. AS SFC TEMPS CONTINUE TO COOL IN THE BOUNDARY LAYER...THE STORMS SHOULD BECOME ELEVATED SUGGESTING THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT MAY BECOME MORE LIMITED LATE THIS EVENING. ALTHOUGH HAIL MAY OCCUR WITH THE MORE INTENSE CELLS...THE GREATER THREAT MAY BE FOR HEAVY RAINFALL MAINLY DUE TO THE VERY SLOW EWD PROGRESSION OF THE CONVECTIVE CLUSTER.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE WITH A LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS MOVING THROUGH THE CENTER OF WW 393. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE AS THE LINE MOVES TOWARD THE SERN EDGE OF THE WATCH. HOWEVER...THE THREAT HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY ISOLATED AND ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE APPEAR UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A INTENSE LINE OF THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING FROM NE KS EXTENDING SWWD INTO NW OK LOCATED JUST AHEAD OF A POCKET OF STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MESOANALYSIS SUGGESTING MLCAPE IS IN THE 3000 TO 4500 J/KG RANGE. THIS ALONG WITH STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL FLOW AHEAD OF THE LINE SHOULD SUSTAIN THE LINEAR MCS SEWD THROUGH PART OF THE OVERNIGHT PERIOD. ALTHOUGH STRONG INSTABILITY EXISTS AHEAD OF THE LINE...FORECAST SOUNDINGS AFTER MIDNIGHT GRADUALLY INCREASE CAPPING ABOVE THE SFC SUGGESTING THE LINE SHOULD BECOME SOMEWHAT ELEVATED. THIS MAY MAKE THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT MARGINAL BUT THE BETTER ORGANIZED BOWING LINE SEGMENTS MAY STILL HAVE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS FOR AT LEAST A FEW MORE HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALTHOUGH AN ISOLATED STRONG WIND GUST CANNOT BE RULED OUT...A CONTINUED DIMINISHING TREND IN THE SVR THREAT ACROSS THIS REGION IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST DURING THE EARLY OVERNIGHT PERIOD. WW 394 COULD POTENTIALLY BE CANCELLED PRIOR TO ITS SCHEDULED 08Z EXPIRATION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SINCE 05Z...TRENDS IN REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY ACROSS SWRN OK AND WRN N TX...ATTENDANT TO AN MCS OVER THIS AREA... INDICATED AN OVERALL WEAKENING IN STORM INTENSITIES ALONG THE LEADING EDGE...WHICH EXTENDED FROM COMANCHE COUNTY OK SWWD TO STONEWALL COUNTY TX. IN ADDITION...THE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY HAS MOVED 10-15 MILES DOWNSTREAM OF THIS LEADING BAND OF TSTMS... WHICH SUGGESTS ANY INFLOW WILL CONTINUE TO BE MORE REMOVED FROM THE ONGOING BAND OF TSTMS...FURTHER REDUCING THE SEVERITY OF THIS MCS. FARTHER NNE...A LINE OF TSTMS WAS TRACKING SEWD INTO NORTH CENTRAL OK...AND HAS EXITED MUCH OF THE NRN EXTENT OF WW 394. COUNTIES ACROSS THIS PART OF THE WATCH CAN BE CANCELLED IN THE WAKE OF THESE STORMS. ..PETERS.. 06/15/2012
